title: Retention-Löschung nach 90 Tagen
description: As a data protection officer, I want old telemetry deleted automatically, so that the platform keeps only what it may keep.

acceptance_criteria.given: log entries, scan raw data and notification records older than 90 days exist and prompts of any age exist
acceptance_criteria.then: the telemetry is deleted and the prompts and versions remain
and: the job writes a summary of the deleted volume
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-028-retention-job.feature: Telemetry older than 90 days is deleted, prompts are kept

acceptance_criteria.given: the retention job has already run successfully
acceptance_criteria.then: the second run deletes nothing and reports zero deleted records without an error
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-028-retention-job.feature: Running the job twice changes nothing

acceptance_criteria.given: the database rejects the deletion statement
acceptance_criteria.then: the job ends with an error, is retried and raises an alert
and: no partial or corrupted state remains
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-028-retention-job.feature: A failing retention job is retried and reported
